title: Machine settings
description: The machine file (design part 13.4): what this machine lets hitld use, kept beside the machine-wide registry at $XDG_DATA_HOME/human-in-the-lead/_machine/machine.json (when XDG_DATA_HOME is unset, %LOCALAPPDATA%\human-in-the-lead\_machine\machine.json on Windows and ~/.local/share/human-in-the-lead/_machine/machine.json elsewhere). Data only: unknown and code-running keys are refused. A key left out is not set at this layer, so the next layer or the default applies. Caps and the port range take the strictest layer; a project may narrow them, never widen them. Internal: never committed or synced.

kind.description: What kind of machine this is; the kind sets the defaults for shares and load checks (design part 13.4, kinds of machine). Was role before HITLD-82.

max_executors.description: The most executors on this machine, from every project. The effective cap is the smallest of this, the person's max_executors, the project's execution.max_executors and the run's cap.

cores.description: The most cores heavy work started by hitld may keep busy (design part 13.4). A later probe that finds fewer cores than this wins.

memory_ceiling_mb.description: Megabytes of memory. Heavy work is not admitted when its expected use would pass this. A later probe that finds less memory wins.

disk_floor_mb.description: Megabytes of free disk below which no new work starts: hitld dispatch plan holds every item and dispatch start refuses. Free disk is the session's allowance where the harness exposes one, else the file system's available space at the checkout, the private store and the worktrees. Without it, 5120. Status, the watchdog and the digest warn below one and a half times this.

capacity.description: How many weight units each resource takes, such as gpu: 4. A holder takes a weight; a resource with no entry has capacity 1.

max_per_core.description: Above this load average per core, heavy work waits.

idle_per_core.description: Below this load average per core, with no executor running, the machine counts as idle: the moment for nightly baselines, evals and reports (design part 13.3). The lower of this and max_per_core applies; without it, 0.25.

detected.description: What `hitld machine detect` found and when (design part 13.4). A record, not a limit: the settings above are what hitld may use. A later probe that finds less than this warns and uses the smaller value.

kind.description: The kind the local hints pointed to. The kind above wins when the person set it.

kind_hints.description: The local hints behind the detected kind.

env.description: What the environment resource manager uses on this machine (design part 13.2). These were policy.json's env keys.

port_range.description: Dev-server ports are leased from this inclusive range. A project may narrow it; the effective range is the overlap.

worktree_root.description: An absolute directory that holds the worktrees, one subdirectory per holder. A project may name a subdirectory under it.

secret_provider.description: Where secret values are read from: keychain, env, or auto (the keychain, then the environment). A project may narrow auto to keychain or env, never widen it.
